text: opus5-20 starting !p1 settings panel refinement. Reading the current panel markup and CSS before touching anything.

Diagnosed the settings panel with real measurements, not taste. A field label renders 16px/600 while a section heading renders 15px/700, so 'Developer mode' is literally BIGGER than 'Theme': the panel has an inverted hierarchy. Vertical gaps down the first group are 12,12,0,0px. Six control heights (13/30/36/40) and five right edges (881.5/884.5/888.2 plus two left-aligned). Repo, branch and token fields are all 88px wide; a fine-grained GitHub token is 93 chars and 88px shows nine. The markdown-download select overhangs the content box by 3.7px. 1630px of content in a 558px box with the title and Reset scrolling away at 40px.

Patch proven in a real browser. tests/board/settings-panel-layout.test.mjs FAILS on the unpatched repo with 10 findings (md select outside the panel at 1440/1024/390, title+Reset gone at the bottom of the scroll, 5 of 9 row-end controls off the content edge, two groups with mixed row gaps, four 13x13 checkboxes, repo and token fields too narrow for their own placeholders) and PASSES with the patch routed in. Five gating suites green with the patch routed in: overlay-wheel-scroll 3/3, toolbar-panel-viewport-fit 30 measurements, theme-and-light-mode 7/7, toolbar-autohide-and-lock, toolbar-dock-position. Result: one label left edge, one control right edge, one row gap per group, a sticky header, GitHub token field 88px -> 326px, contrast 6.56:1 worst case in light and 9.07:1 in dark.

Done. patch.json has 4 hunks (1 CSS, 3 JS), all anchors re-verified unique against the working tree at the end. Apply me LAST; I deliberately do not touch ensureThemeSettingsUi, and the CSS is one appended block anchored inside the settings region rather than at the file tail so an appending agent will not collide. Two observations that are not mine: content/boards/cosmoboard/current.canvas has diverged from HEAD and is missing six HEAD node ids (I proved my runs issued zero /api/save-board requests, so it is not me), and somebody ran a build at 12:20 that rewrote the cache-buster hashes in content/boards/*.html. Preview server still up on 4192.
